patch:
diff --git a/src/click/double_count_action.py b/src/click/double_count_action.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..150fa33
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/double_count_action.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import typing as t
+
+from click.parser import _Option
+from click.parser import _ParsingState
+
+
+class DoubleCountAction(_Option):
+    def process(self, value: t.Any, state: _ParsingState) -> None:
+        if self.action == "count":
+            state.opts[self.dest] = state.opts.get(self.dest, 0) + 2  # type: ignore
+            state.order.append(self.obj)
+        else:
+            super().process(value, state)
notes:
Added DoubleCountAction subclassing _Option; for action='count' it mirrors _Option.process with +2 (including state.order append), all other actions delegate to super().process unchanged.
Agent-reported tests_run (not independently verified): "pip install -e .; inline python smoke test asserting two count calls yield 4 with order appended, and store action stores value via super() \u2014 passed"
